RE-VERDICTED 2026-07-26 (potion-scope re-verdict pass), from waiver. The shared contract's 'Out of scope everywhere: potions (deferred by Perry)' has been DELETED on Perry's instruction ("don't ignore potions anymore"). `potion` is now an ordinary audit kind -- 51 sim units, audit/records/potion/, `harness.py roster potion` -- and it is UNAUDITED, exactly like `monster`. So the guard is re-derived on its merits: the applier potion is read in full against its C# model and verdicted here.
THE APPLIER IS FAITHFUL, AND IT CARRIES THE SAME TWO-NUMBER TRAP THIS RECORD'S GUARD ON RadiancePower.cs:25 DESCRIBES. src/Core/Models/Potions/RadiantTincture.cs:24-28 declares TWO vars, new EnergyVar(1) and new PowerVar<RadiancePower>(3m), with no AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension in the file: 1 is the energy per turn and 3 is the STACK COUNT (the number of turns). RadiantTincture.cs:33 spends the first as an immediate `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(DynamicVars.Energy.IntValue, target.Player)` and RadiantTincture.cs:34 applies RadiancePower with the second. sts2_rl/potions.py:856-857 keeps them apart the same way (ENERGY = 1, RADIANCE = 3) and sts2_rl/potions.py:862-865 keeps the order -- EnergyCmd.gain first, PowerCmd.apply second -- so the immediate energy is not routed through the power. Swapping the two numbers would give 1 turn of 3 energy instead of 3 turns of 1. APPLIER: C#'s fourth argument is `base.Owner.Creature` (parameter `Creature? applier`, src/Core/Commands/PowerCmd.cs:101), matching `applier=ctx.player`. TargetType.AnyPlayer (RadiantTincture.cs:20) and AssertValidForTargetedPotion (RadiantTincture.cs:32) are the multiplayer target-validity path, waived as multiplayer; ExtraHoverTips (RadiantTincture.cs:22) is presentation. REACHABILITY IS ESTABLISHED, NOT WAIVED (binding rule 6): @register_potion puts it in ALL_POTIONS and it is in the generation pool at sts2_rl/potion_pools.py:58 (uncommon); the conformance runner asserts the belt slot by slot (sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:625-631). WHAT IS STILL NOT JUDGED HERE is a coverage fact, not a verdict: `potion/radiant_tincture` has no record yet because the whole potion kind is unaudited. Nothing in this record depends on it.
